condiments.name: Wallpaper
condiments.description: Background images for Snacks, excluding M Snacks. Fill, fit or stretch without changing the source.

agent.instructions: Wallpaper is entirely implemented by this external Condiment. Discover condiment-agent-guide to read its command schemas. Open it with condiment-open if necessary, then use condiment-command with this Condiment id and command apply (snackId, managed mediaId, fit cover/contain/stretch) or remove (snackId). Its commands call generic presentation tools; Snack has no Wallpaper-specific code. Upload chosen images with media-begin/media-chunk/media-finish. Verify presentation-state for the target Snack. Use only the user’s requested target and current permissions. M Snacks (kind image) are excluded from both the picker and apply command. Verify the chosen target kind before applying.

skills.name: snack-wallpaper
skills.description: Apply or remove a wallpaper on a selected Snack.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply this Condiment’s wallpaper to a Snack.
